issue.title: Atomic sidecar publication rejects empty remotes before initialization can seed them
issue.description: Proposed by sase-12w.4 note 1 and sase-12w.5 note 1; independently reproduced by sase-12w land audit at 9243c0bdd7. The four-file focused rerun of test_sidecar_bead_adoption.py, test_sidecar_init_creation.py, test_sidecar_init_reconciliation.py, and test_linked_repo_workspaces.py::test_sidecar_materialization_uses_remote_not_divergent_primary yields 14 failures and 1 pass. Unrelated commit cd7b9f9fd8 added an unconditional resolvable-HEAD/upstream check in validate_staged_sdd_clone. initialize_sidecars clones newly created/adopted empty bare remotes before _seed_sidecars, so 13 bootstrap/migration cases fail before seeding. Define a safe intentional-empty bootstrap path while retaining rejection of corrupt existing clones and atomic publication guarantees. Update the remaining test assertion for staging destinations without losing its remote-versus-divergent-primary guarantee. One task covers both proposals because their root change and remediation are shared. Size large: the valid empty-clone contract needs planning across clone validation and sidecar initialization.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Both phase agents reproduced this, and the land agent independently reran the exact affected files on an unchanged tree: 14 failures, 1 pass. The unconditional HEAD guard deterministically rejects the deliberately empty remote before seeding; a separate assertion deterministically assumes the obsolete final clone destination.
